Class LostBearings

java.lang.Object
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.game.Maps.GameMap
de.lmu.dbs.ifi.sep25.game.Maps.LostBearings
public class LostBearings extends GameMap
The LostBearings class defines the game map layout for the "Lost Bearings" map variant. It sets up all game elements such as walls, belts, pits, energy spaces, gears, lasers, and checkpoints for the 1A sub-board and the shared "StartA" board.
